swimming_pool.evidence: The blue pools at the top-left (small, near the house's rear) and the left edge appear to be on neighboring lots. The small one at top-left is close to the central house but is likely on the adjacent property.

solar_panels.evidence: Regular blue-dark rectangular grids on several roof faces of the central house, including a large array on the lower roof section and panels on the upper-left roof sections.
solar_panels.detail: Multiple roof-mounted arrays on the central house

detached_structure.evidence: The structure at the lower left looks like a separate house on a neighboring lot rather than a shed or garage on the central lot.

signals.notes: The central house has multi-section roofs with several solar arrays and a driveway to the lower right with two dark vehicles. Mature trees surround the lot and shade much of the yard, and a small pool at the upper left may belong to the adjacent lot.
